target_questions.question: Does the paper independently support injection interval and pressure as controls on pilot-ignited natural-gas heat release and stability?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A020 and A030 identify dwell and sequence as mechanism anchors; the title and abstract indicate an engine-scale operating-parameter sweep.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: Within the tested pilot-ignited direct-injection natural-gas engine, shorter injection interval and higher injection pressure changed peak heat release, combustion stability, and fuel economy.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: The experimental parameter sweep reports coordinated combustion-response changes with injection interval, pilot pulse width, timing, and pressure.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: injection interval and pilot-main interaction chronology

limitations: Engine-specific operating range; correlated parameter effects do not establish a universal optimum.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
